title: Guards vs Body Conditions
goal: Ensure unmatched conditions fall through to subsequent arms.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Pattern Matching

hints: A match guard uses `if` right after the pattern to restrict when the arm matches.
Ensure both positive check and parity check are included in the guard condition.
explanation: Match guards use the syntax `pattern if condition`. If the condition evaluates to false, matching falls through to subsequent arms. Omitting the `x > 0` check causes negative even numbers to match the first arm. Using `_` in the second arm causes negative odd numbers to be misclassified as positive odd.
